map.两个常见原因：一是停用词表不匹配，把「方法」「问题」这类无区分度的词也算进来；二: Two common causes. First, the stop-word list does not fit, so low-discrimination words are included. Second, Chinese is not tokenized correctly, producing meaningless fragments. The fix is to expand the stop-word list, add a custom dictionary (domain terms), and sort the results by TF-IDF or TextRank score before taking the top ones.
